title: India as an AI hedge? The country's stocks could see robust inflows as markets globally tank
summary_full: Over the last month, India's Nifty 50 has gained nearly 9%, while markets with heavy AI exposure, including the U.S., Japan, South Korea and Taiwan are deep in the red.
